description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of a gold prefix and BLEU scores for consistency and inconsistency. The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale, ranges from 23 to 29, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue dashed line with circle markers represents "Consistency: wait-1", starting at a value of approximately 25.2 at x=0, decreasing to a value of approximately 23.5 at x=3, then increasing to a value of approximately 28.5 at x=20. A red dashed line with square markers represents "Inconsistency: wait-9", starting at a value of approximately 26.2 at x=0, fluctuating between approximately 25.2 and 26.5 until x=15, and then increasing to a value of approximately 25.8 at x=20.
